questions.question_text: Which of the following core symptoms of autism has demonstrated minimal success in treatment with risperidone?

options.text: Repetitive and stereotyped patterns of behavior
Deficits in social interaction and communication

correct_answer.text: Deficits in social interaction and communication

correct_answers.text: Deficits in social interaction and communication

questions.explanation: Risperidone has modest benefits in improving deficits in social interaction and communication, despite being effective for aggression and other symptoms.

questions.question_text: All of the following medications have a role in the treatment of tics EXCEPT:
questions.explanation: Atomoxetine does not have a role in the management of tics and is reported to exacerbate tics in children with ADHD.

questions.question_text: Which of the following interventions has the highest priority for a 16-year-old boy being treated for schizophrenia, showing withdrawal and lack of interest?

options.text: Assessment of social and educational needs of the patient
Conduct an Abnormal Involuntary Movement Scale test (AIMS) exam
Monitor for metabolic side effects of paliperidone by obtaining fasting lipid profile
Family and individual counseling about schizophrenia
Assess for symptoms of major depression and consider antidepressant treatment

correct_answer.text: Assess for symptoms of major depression and consider antidepressant treatment

correct_answers.text: Assess for symptoms of major depression and consider antidepressant treatment

questions.explanation: Adolescent schizophrenia is often accompanied by negative symptoms and depressive symptoms; assessing for depression and considering treatment is critical.

questions.question_text: Which of the following is used as a first-line agent in the treatment of enuresis?
questions.explanation: Desmopressin is the first-line treatment for primary nocturnal enuresis.

questions.question_text: All of the following statements are true except regarding the use of clonidine in children EXCEPT:

options.text: Clonidine is useful in the pharmacologic treatment of Tourette syndrome in children
Sedation is the most frequent and troublesome side effect of clonidine
Clonidine has a long half-life, and it is administered orally once or twice a day
Personal history of cardiovascular disease is contraindication for starting clonidine therapy in children
Clonidine should be titrated gradually, and dose can be increased every 2 to 3 days

correct_answer.text: Clonidine has a long half-life, and it is administered orally once or twice a day

correct_answers.text: Clonidine has a long half-life, and it is administered orally once or twice a day

questions.explanation: Clonidine has a very short half-life and is typically administered three to four times daily instead.

questions.question_text: What is the most appropriate next step in the management of a 14-year-old female with depression who has not responded to two SSRIs?

options.text: Reassess diagnosis; especially rule out bipolar disorder or comorbid ADHD

correct_answer.text: Reassess diagnosis; especially rule out bipolar disorder or comorbid ADHD

correct_answers.text: Reassess diagnosis; especially rule out bipolar disorder or comorbid ADHD

questions.explanation: It is important to reevaluate and confirm the diagnosis and rule out comorbid conditions like bipolar disorder or ADHD before considering augmentation.

questions.question_text: You are treating a 15-year-old adolescent boy for ADHD and comorbid depression. Which management will be the most appropriate next step?

options.text: Prescribe a combination of fluoxetine and a stimulant such as methylphenidate
Start bupropion for depression and ADHD

questions.explanation: In addressing the bigger problem of depression, attempting a trial of fluoxetine would target both sets of symptoms.

questions.question_text: All of the following statements regarding psychostimulant growth slowdown are true EXCEPT:

options.text: Stimulant-induced appetite suppression and reduced caloric intake may play a role in growth retardation
Height and weight gain should be recorded once a year in patients receiving stimulants
Stimulants may suppress growth hormone release
In the presence of height or weight velocity, dose reduction has no role and change to another class of medication must be carried out

correct_answer.text: Height and weight gain should be recorded once a year in patients receiving stimulants

correct_answers.text: Height and weight gain should be recorded once a year in patients receiving stimulants

questions.explanation: Height and weight should be monitored periodically for growth suppression, not just once a year.

questions.question_text: Which of the following statements is true regarding the differences in drug metabolism between children and adults?

options.text: Children have lower glomerular filtration rates
Children may more rapidly excrete the drug that uses either hepatic or renal pathways
Children have slower hepatic drug metabolism
Children have proportionally smaller liver tissue

correct_answer.text: Children may more rapidly excrete the drug that uses either hepatic or renal pathways

correct_answers.text: Children may more rapidly excrete the drug that uses either hepatic or renal pathways

questions.explanation: Children have proportionally more liver tissue, leading to faster metabolism, and they also have higher glomerular filtration rates.

questions.question_text: Which of the following statement is true regarding the pharmacologic treatment of ADHD symptoms among children and adolescents with intellectual disability?

options.text: Combination of antipsychotic and stimulant is the standard of care
Antidepressants should be the first line of treatment
Risperidone should be the first line of treatment
Stimulants should be the first line of treatment
Anticonvulsants should be the first line of treatment

correct_answer.text: Stimulants should be the first line of treatment

correct_answers.text: Stimulants should be the first line of treatment

questions.explanation: Stimulants like methylphenidate are first-line treatments for ADHD symptoms in children with intellectual disabilities.

questions.question_text: Which of the following statement is true regarding the pharmacotherapy of ADHD?

options.text: Methylphenidate is approved for children >6 years
Methylphenidate is approved for children >5 years
Methylphenidate is approved for children >7 years
Methylphenidate is approved for children >4 years
Methylphenidate is approved for children >2 to 3 years

correct_answer.text: Methylphenidate is approved for children >6 years

correct_answers.text: Methylphenidate is approved for children >6 years

questions.explanation: Methylphenidate is only approved for children older than 6 years, due to a lack of established safety and efficacy for younger patients.

questions.question_text: Which of the following statement is true regarding the pharmacotherapy of ADHD with amphetamine?

options.text: Amphetamine can be safely used in children with structural cardiac abnormalities
Amphetamine is approved for children >3 years
Amphetamine can be safely used in a patient with hyperthyroidism
Amphetamine can be safely used within a week following discontinuation of monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MAOIs)
Amphetamine is approved for children >6 years

correct_answer.text: Amphetamine is approved for children >3 years

correct_answers.text: Amphetamine is approved for children >3 years

questions.explanation: Amphetamine is approved for children older than 3 years; its safety and efficacy have not been established for younger patients.

questions.question_text: Among children, which of the following medications affects cardiovascular functioning and may prolong QTc even at therapeutic doses?
questions.explanation: First-generation and second-generation antipsychotics, tricyclic antidepressants, and lithium can all affect cardiovascular functioning.

questions.question_text: Which of the following is the most common side effect with intranasal Desmopressin?
questions.explanation: Headache is the most common side effect reported during the use of intranasal desmopressin.

questions.question_text: Which of the following medications is FDA approved for major depressive disorder (MDD) in adolescents?
questions.explanation: Escitalopram and fluoxetine are currently approved by the FDA for the treatment of pediatric depression.

questions.question_text: Which of the following statements is true regarding the pharmacokinetics in children?

options.text: Children have proportionally less adipose tissue than adults
Children have proportionally less total-body water than adults
Children have higher plasma concentrations of hydrophilic drugs than adults
Children have lower plasma concentrations of lipophilic drugs

correct_answer.text: Children have proportionally less adipose tissue than adults

correct_answers.text: Children have proportionally less adipose tissue than adults

questions.explanation: Children have proportionally less adipose tissue than adults, but their total body water is higher, influencing drug pharmacokinetics.

questions.question_text: B-adrenergic agents are used in the management of aggression associated with which of the following conditions?
questions.explanation: β-Adrenergic agents are employed in managing aggression related to various conditions, including those mentioned.

questions.question_text: Which of the following statements is not true regarding psychopharmacotherapy between children and adults?

options.text: Treatment in child psychiatry is mostly multidisciplinary in nature
Metabolism of drugs differs between children and adults
Abundant research data on pediatric psychopharmacology is available
Efficacy and tolerability of psychotropic drugs differs between children and adults
Psychopharmacotherapy in children is distinct from adults

correct_answer.text: Abundant research data on pediatric psychopharmacology is available

correct_answers.text: Abundant research data on pediatric psychopharmacology is available

questions.explanation: There is actually little data available on pediatric psychopharmacology compared to adult studies.

questions.question_text: All of the following statements regarding dexmethylphenidate (Focalin) are true EXCEPT:

options.text: The difference in duration of action between dexmethylphenidate and methylphenidate is not clinically significant
Studies indicate a more favorable adverse effect profile for dexmethylphenidate compared to methylphenidate
Dexmethylphenidate can be administered by sprinkling the capsule contents on a small amount of applesauce
For patients currently on methylphenidate, the recommended starting dose of dexmethylphenidate is half the total daily dose of racemic methylphenidate
Dexmethylphenidate is the active D-enantiomer of racemic methylphenidate

correct_answer.text: Studies indicate a more favorable adverse effect profile for dexmethylphenidate compared to methylphenidate

correct_answers.text: Studies indicate a more favorable adverse effect profile for dexmethylphenidate compared to methylphenidate

questions.explanation: Studies have not shown a more favorable adverse effect profile for dexmethylphenidate compared to methylphenidate.

questions.question_text: All of the following statements regarding lisdexamfetamine are true EXCEPT:

options.text: Lisdexamfetamine is not metabolized by cytochrome P450 enzymes
It is a schedule II drug which means that automated refills are not allowed
It is a prodrug of dextroamphetamine
Lisdexamfetamine dimesylate has lower abuse potential
The drug's short duration of action is a key determinant of its efficacy in school-going children with ADHD

correct_answer.text: The drug's short duration of action is a key determinant of its efficacy in school-going children with ADHD

correct_answers.text: The drug's short duration of action is a key determinant of its efficacy in school-going children with ADHD

questions.explanation: Lisdexamfetamine actually has a long-acting duration of effect which is important for its efficacy in school-aged children.

questions.question_text: Which of the following must be closely monitored during guanfacine therapy?
questions.explanation: Guanfacine therapy is associated with decreased blood pressure, thus requiring periodic monitoring.

questions.question_text: Which of the following can be a potential risk factor for increased blood pressure and seizure in children taking Atomoxetine?
questions.explanation: Poor metabolizers can see a significant increase in atomoxetine levels, raising the risk of high blood pressure and seizures.

questions.question_text: Which of the following medications has the strongest evidence for the management of aggression and self-injurious behavior in children with autism spectrum disorders?
questions.explanation: Methylphenidate has strong evidence supporting its use in managing aggression and self-injurious behavior in autism.

questions.question_text: Which of the following statements is true regarding cardiovascular assessment and monitoring during pediatric ADHD pharmacotherapy?

options.text: The American Heart Association requires a mandatory electrocardiogram (EKG) before starting stimulants in ADHD
Clinical studies have demonstrated statistically significant changes in QTc parameters during pediatric ADHD pharmacotherapy with stimulants as well as non-stimulants
There is an FDA black box warning regarding cardiovascular fatalities associated with the use of stimulants in ADHD
The link between stimulants and sudden death in children is well established

questions.explanation: No definitive causality has been established between serious cardiovascular events and stimulant use.

questions.question_text: Which of the following is true regarding Alpha-adrenergic agonist therapy in children?

options.text: Clonidine is used in the management of tics
Guanfacine is used in the management of Gilles de la Tourette syndrome
Clonidine is used in the management of ADHD
Guanfacine is FDA-approved treatment for ADHD

questions.explanation: Each option reflects correct uses of alpha-adrenergic agonists in managing the mentioned conditions.

questions.question_text: Which of the following mood stabilizers have been associated with the development of polycystic ovarian syndrome (PCOS)?
questions.explanation: Valproic acid has been associated with the development of PCOS, especially in young women.

questions.question_text: Which of the following is proven to be efficacious in the treatment of Tourette disorder?
questions.explanation: Pimozide is FDA-approved for the treatment of Gilles de la Tourette syndrome.

questions.question_text: What is the next best step in the management of a 10-year-old girl with ADHD and a family history of long QT syndrome who is being considered for stimulant therapy?

options.text: Start bupropion instead of a stimulant

questions.explanation: In cases of risk factors for cardiac disease, including family history, it is essential to perform an ECG before starting stimulant therapy.

questions.question_text: All of the following are true regarding methylphenidate EXCEPT:

options.text: It is inconclusive whether or not prolonged use of methylphenidate can significantly limit height and body weight
Routine baseline EKGs are recommended before starting methylphenidate therapy
The drug inhibits reuptake of dopamine and norepinephrine into presynaptic neurons
The efficacy and safety of methylphenidate has not been established in patients <6 years of age
Dexmethylphenidate (Focalin) is the D-enantiomer of methylphenidate

correct_answer.text: Routine baseline EKGs are recommended before starting methylphenidate therapy

correct_answers.text: Routine baseline EKGs are recommended before starting methylphenidate therapy

questions.explanation: Routine EKGs are indicated only in cases of personal or family history of cardiac conditions, not as a baseline for all patients.

questions.question_text: All of the following statements regarding methylphenidate transdermal system are true EXCEPT:

options.text: The patch should be applied to the hip area and should be removed 6 hours after application
The transdermal formulation produces higher exposures of dexmethylphenidate compared with oral administration
It is dosed once a day
The effect on average dissipates 3 hours after patch removal

correct_answer.text: The patch should be applied to the hip area and should be removed 6 hours after application

correct_answers.text: The patch should be applied to the hip area and should be removed 6 hours after application

questions.explanation: The transdermal patch must be applied 2 hours before the needed effect and should only be removed 9 hours after application.

questions.question_text: Which of the following is the first-line pharmacotherapy for childhood anxiety disorder?
questions.explanation: SSRIs like sertraline are established as the first-line treatment for childhood anxiety disorders.

questions.question_text: All of the following statements regarding Atomoxetine are true EXCEPT:

options.text: Atomoxetine has a black box warning for suicidal ideation in children and adolescents
Middle insomnia is characteristic of noradrenergic rebound and might be expected during Atomoxetine therapy
Atomoxetine has no effect on blood pressure and pulse when compared with stimulants

correct_answer.text: Atomoxetine has no effect on blood pressure and pulse when compared with stimulants

correct_answers.text: Atomoxetine has no effect on blood pressure and pulse when compared with stimulants

questions.explanation: Atomoxetine is reported to increase systolic and diastolic blood pressure, in contrast to what option C states.

questions.question_text: Which of the following statement is true regarding neuroleptic-induced extrapyramidal side effects among children and adolescents?

options.text: Quetiapine is associated with lower EPS
Children and adolescents are more sensitive than adults to EPS associated with atypical antipsychotics
Risk of extrapyramidal symptoms (EPS) increases with higher doses of Aripiprazole
Children and adolescents are more sensitive than adults to EPS associated with typical antipsychotics

questions.explanation: Each statement regarding the increased risk of EPS with higher doses and sensitivity differences between children and adults is true.

questions.question_text: Which of the following is true regarding the management of insomnia in pediatric patients?

options.text: Cognitive behavioral therapy has very limited role in the management of insomnia
Zaleplon because of its shorter half-life is the preferred agent
There is no FDA-approved agent for the management of insomnia
Nonpharmacologic therapy combined with pharmacotherapy yields the optimal response

correct_answer.text: There is no FDA-approved agent for the management of insomnia

correct_answers.text: There is no FDA-approved agent for the management of insomnia

questions.explanation: Currently, there is no FDA-approved medication for treating insomnia in children; nonpharmacologic therapies are preferred.

questions.question_text: All of the following SSRIs are FDA approved treatment for obsessive compulsive disorder (OCD) EXCEPT:
questions.explanation: All options except for option D are SSRIs that have been FDA approved for the treatment of OCD.

questions.question_text: Which of the following treatment is associated with better outcome in primary nocturnal enuresis?
questions.explanation: Bell and pad conditioning has shown better outcomes in preventing relapse of enuresis after treatment compared to medications.
